description: Look up a Scroll transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in ETH, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use scroll_receipt, for emitted events scroll_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x0176fb42be8ea0058d1ac56cb253f0df883ba4b564489e71b83fb7e27e912abd. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: scroll_tx
title: Scroll transaction
